issue_description.description: Audited the current diff against baseline b0ef37717a7dcde41d63003c3ccbee1a9664c25f and the supplied baseline record. Traced the consolidated entry through guarded modules, newsletter and navigation callers, heading copy and focus handling, the delayed dialog, supplement filter reordering and native hashes, and the contents tracker's 10px landing line, document-bottom rule, visibility suppression and anchor-follow exception. Inspected current emitted HTML and its shared module. No concrete reachable regression was supported. Recommendation: retain the existing verification coverage; no application change is recommended by this partition. Coverage limits: this worker did not run builds, start a browser or server, execute E2E or accessibility suites, make external requests, or inspect other audit reports. Emitted output is the build present during review and was not regenerated by this worker.
issue_description.code_example: Read-only emitted-output check inspected all 20 dist/client HTML documents: - Exactly one main element with id="main-content" and tabindex="-1" per document. - Exactly one shared BaseLayout script entry per document. - No external stylesheet links. - Shared emitted entry contains the supplement, delayed dialog and navigation module selectors.

Actual: source and emitted-output inspection found these contracts consistent; no supported defect was recorded.
